items.title: Animal Masks
items.creator: WildPhire
items.description:
Step into a world where every creature hides behind a wild new identity — welcome to Animal Masks. Each skin features a bold mask design, unique personality, and playful animal flair. Choose your masked character and jump into fun role‑play adventures as you prowl, pounce, and protect your territory.
- 5 High‑Quality Skins
- Animal‑Inspired Mask Designs
- Unleash Your Wild

items.title: Banana Bandits
items.creator: WildPhire
items.description:
Step into a world ruled by the sneakiest simians around — the Banana Bandits. Each bandit skin brings its own quirky charm, daring attitude, and mischievous flair. Pick your bandit and jump into wild role‑play escapades as you climb your way to the top of the troop.

- 5 High‑Quality Skins
- Bandit‑Themed Banana‑Loving Designs
- Steal the Spotlight and Go Wild!

items.title: Creepy Icons
items.creator: Creator Games
items.description: Descend into the abyss of fear and confront creatures torn straight from your darkest nightmares. Twisted faces leer from the shadows, eyes follow your every move from impossible angles, and shapes warp and bend in ways that defy all logic. Dare to look closer?

items.title: Nekochic
items.creator: Owls Cubed
items.description: Meet a charming crew of ten cat-eared characters dressed in cozy, fashion-forward outfits in warm cream and ginger tones. Striped tabby patterns, a soft touch of Japanese flair, and blooming cherry-blossom vibes turn every look into a purr-fectly stylish little icon. Pick your favorite furry persona and bring some feline grace to any world!

items.title: ANOMALY SPECTRUM
items.creator: Carper Creative
items.description: ANOMALY SPECTRUM brings 80 corrupted shadow skins glowing with strange colors and mysterious energy. Become a glitch, a phantom, a void entity, or something no one can explain. Pick your anomaly and stand out in every world!

items.title: Custom Hunger
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Custom Hunger! Craft new foods and eat them when you're hungry to activate the custom hunger bar. There are 20 new foods and each one gives adds special effect when eaten.

+20 New foods!
+Special effects!
+Custom hunger bar!

This item uses random start areas for any new world. Endless possibilities!

items.title: Dimension Homes Add-On
items.creator: Chunklabs
items.description:
A dimension of your own awaits! Blast through a portal of flames and carve out a realm beyond. Start small and transform your world into a legendary kingdom in the sky.
- Build YOUR dream dimension from the ground up
- Unlock upgrades & brand-new islands
- Watch your realm grow bigger and stronger
- Keep it solo or build your dimension with friends

items.title: Hospital
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
Be the hospital hero! Choose any of these epic nurse, doctor, and medic outfits with the Hospital skin pack!

+ Great for hospital roleplay

items.title: Glow Aegis
items.creator: Fun Creators
items.description:
Gear up with Glow Aegis! Featuring a massive collection of 80 skins, this pack combines sleek dark armor with brilliant neon glowing lines. Become a futuristic knight or neon warrior in cyan, gold, purple, and red. Dominate the arena and protect your realm with ultimate power! 

- 80 epic high-definition armor skins 
- Glowing neon and dark armor 
- Massive variety for PvP

items.title: Pastel Beige HD
items.creator: Wonder
items.description: Step into every adventure with these pastel beige HD outfits. Soft tones and clean designs make them perfect for any occasion.

items.title: Fairy HD
items.creator: Wonder
items.description: Fairy HD! Discover magical characters with enchanted outfits, sparkling accessories, and vibrant HD fantasy-inspired designs.

items.title: Bunny Teens HD
items.creator: Wonder
items.description: Bunny Teens HD! Show off cute teen characters featuring cozy bunny-themed outfits, pastel fashion, playful accessories, and detailed HD designs.

items.title: Pastel Light Blue HD
items.creator: Wonder
items.description: Refresh your style with these pastel light blue HD outfits. Clean, modern, and perfect for every adventure.

items.title: Cherry Blossom Teens HD
items.creator: Wonder
items.description: Cherry Blossom Teens! Step into spring with fashionable teen characters featuring floral-inspired outfits, trendy casual styles.

items.title: Sulfur Strongholds Add-On
items.creator: Float Studios
items.description:
Hidden in the Sulfur Cave biomes lie four ancient strongholds - Air, Earth, Ice, and Slime. Hit the cube, unlock the door, claim the core!

Solve physics puzzles with elemental Sulfur Cubes: slime bounces off walls, ice glides across rooms, air drifts and hangs. Push them onto pressure plates to power the Sulfur doors and battle through three levels to the trophy chamber.

items.title: Obsidian Knights
items.creator: Piki Studios
items.description:
Become a legendary defender! Suit up in heavy dark armor forged from strong volcanic glass and powered by glowing red energy. These fearless warriors are ready to defend the castle and defeat any enemies.

- 8 heavy armored knights!
- Perfect for roleplays!

By Piki Studios

items.title: Shadow Guards
items.creator: Piki Studios
items.description:
Protect the secrets of the dark! Put on heavy stealth suits featuring glowing neon eyes in bright colors. These mysterious warriors are ready to hide in the shadows and guard your base.

- 8 guard skins!
- Perfect for roleplays!

By Piki Studios

items.title: Galactic Commanders
items.creator: Piki Studios
items.description:
Take control of the cosmos with this skin pack! Put on advanced space suits with bright helmets and cool cosmic armor. Lead your crew across the stars and discover new worlds!

- 8 Commander Skins!
- Perfect for roleplays!

By Piki Studios

items.title: Orange Gamers
items.creator: Piki Studios
items.description:
Level up your look with these stylish skins! Put on comfy orange hoodies, cool headsets, and gaming gears. Hang out with your friends and show off your ultimate gaming style.

- 8 Gamer Skins!
- Perfect for roleplays with friends!

By Piki Studios

items.title: Ender Knights
items.creator: Piki Studios
items.description:
Become a legendary defender of the End with the Ender Knights! Suit up in powerful dark armor infused with glowing purple energy. These elite warriors are ready to protect their dimension from any threat.

- 8 Knight Skins!
- Perfect for roleplays!

By Piki Studios

items.title: Porcelain Mobs
items.creator: Piki Studios
items.description:
Smash the competition with these shiny, blue-and-white porcelain monster designs! Equip now to become a beautiful ceramic legend.

- 8 Different Mobs!
- Perfect for roleplays.

By Piki Studios

items.title: Statue Mobs

items.description:
Awaken from your slumber in these solid, moss-covered mob designs! Equip now to stomp around as a powerful living statue.

- 8 Skins!
- Perfect for roleplays.
- By Piki Studios

items.title: Teen Footballers
items.creator: Lore Studios
items.description:
Hit the field and score big goals with the Teen Footballers! Put on soccer jerseys and get ready to play in the big stadium. Pick your favorite team outfit and show off your best sports moves with your friends.

- 40+ different jerseys.
- Perfect with friends!
- By Lore Studios

items.title: Damaged Bots
items.creator: Lore Studios
items.description:
Spark fear with these cracked, heavy metal machine styles! Get the pack today and rule the night as a glitchy bots.

- 8 Types!
- Perfect for roleplays!
- By Lore Studios
